product_metadata.title: puredown® Goose Feather Down Comforter Twin Size, All Season Duvet Insert, Cloud Soft Hotel Collection Bedding Comforters 100% Cotton Shell, Black
features: 【Ultra-Soft Fabric】- These goose down feather comforters are magnificently soft, smooth, and pleasantly weighty, the shell is made from 100% cotton, makes it much softer and more comfortable on the skin. The comforters are noiseless, creating almost no rustling sounds even as you toss and turn on your bed. They're down-proof so there won't be any annoying filling poking at you and disturbing your slumber.

【Only Responsibly-Sourced Stuffing】- Our goose down duvet inserts are filled with 95% goose feather and 5% goose down, and in line with Responsible Down Standards (RDS), OEKO-TEX. The recyclable down and feather fillings we used are carefully selected and thoroughly cleaned before they're stuffed inside the shell.

【Fluffy & Warm】- We designed our all season down comforters with box construction. With these features, the fillings will always be evenly distributed throughout the comforter, and keep the comforters fluffy. This in turn helps prevent clumping, which is not just uncomfortable but also creates cold spots in the blanket.

【Unique Design】- Our down comforter twin size (68*90”) features double-needle stitching and piping to enhance its durability. This keeps the top and bottom shells together better and prevents the seams from opening up and the filling leaking out.
【A Comforter For Everyone】- These down duvet inserts are moisture-wicking, breathable, and moderately warm so they're suitable for use in any season.
